name: Multidots Doodle – Automatically update logos for holidays, seasons, or promotions
author: MULTIDOTS Inc

sections.description:
Multidots Doodle is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to automatically change your site’s logo based on occasions, festivals, or special events.

With Multidots Doodle, you can:

  • Schedule Logo Changes: Set start and end dates for when specific logos should appear
  • Multiple Logo Variants: Support for primary, dark mode, light mode, and mobile-specific logos
  • Automatic Detection: Smart detection of dark/light mode and mobile devices
  • Annual Repetition: Set logos to appear automatically every year for recurring events
  • Easy Management: User-friendly interface to manage all your occasion-based logos
  • Preview Support: Test your logo rules on your website

🎯 Perfect For

  • Celebrating festivals and holidays with themed logos
  • Showing support for special causes or awareness months
  • Running seasonal branding campaigns
  • Maintaining brand consistency across different device types and themes
  • Automating logo changes for recurring events

🔥 Key Features

  1. Occasion-based Rules

    • Create unlimited logo rules
    • Set specific date ranges
    • Enable annual repetition for recurring events

  2. Smart Logo Variants

    • Primary logo for default display
    • Dark mode variant for dark themes
    • Light mode variant for light themes
    • Mobile-specific logo for better mobile experience

  3. Automatic Detection

    • Detects user’s theme preference (dark/light)
    • Identifies mobile devices
    • Switches logos automatically

  4. Easy Management

    • Intuitive admin interface
    • Quick enable/disable toggles

  5. Developer Friendly

    • Clean, well-documented code
    • Hooks and filters for customization
    • Performance optimized
    • Compatible with major themes

sections.installation:
• Download the plugin
  • Upload the folder “multidots-doodle” to wp-content/plugins (or upload a zip through the WordPress admin)
  • Activate and enjoy!
sections.faq:
How do I create my first logo rule?

  1. Go to Multidots Doodle > Add New Rule in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter a title or occasion name
  3. Set the start and end dates
  4. Upload your primary logo
  5. Optionally add dark mode, light mode, and mobile variants
  6. Save the rule

Can I schedule logos for recurring events?

Yes! When creating or editing a rule, check the “Repeat Annually” option. The logo will automatically appear each year during the specified dates.

How does dark mode detection work?

Multidots Doodle automatically detects the user’s system theme preference and browser settings. When dark mode is detected, it displays the dark mode variant of your logo if available.

What happens if I don’t upload a variant logo?

If a variant (dark/light/mobile) logo isn’t uploaded, Multidots Doodle will fallback to using the primary logo for that scenario.

What happens when multiple rules overlap?

When date ranges overlap, Multidots Doodle uses the most recently created active rule. You can reorder rules by adjusting their dates.

Is Multidots Doodle compatible with my theme?

Multidots Doodle is designed to work with any WordPress theme that uses standard logo implementation. You can also customize the CSS selectors in the plugin’s Javascript Fallback Method settings for perfect compatibility.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No, Multidots Doodle is optimized for performance. It uses WordPress best practices and loads assets only when needed.
